$comment: THE AUDIT VERB TABLE — the SOLE authority for two vocabularies that used to be two hand-lists. (1) BarkparkCloud.Accounts.AuditEvent's closed @actions allowlist reads `actions[].verb` at COMPILE time (@external_resource + Jason.decode!), so validate_inclusion(:action, @actions) still enforces the identical closed set. (2) The console's ACTION_LABELS object in cloud/priv/static/app.js is a BEGIN/END GENERATED region emitted from `actions[].label` by design/emit.mjs and digest-fenced by design/emit-manifest.json. NEITHER side greps the other's syntax: both are OUTPUTS of this file. A row IS the declaration, and its label rides on it — so a label for an undeclared verb has nowhere to live (charter cch-w65). `label: null` is legal and means the console renders the raw dotted slug through humanAction's documented fallback (charter D582: ugly, not false) — but a null MUST carry `reason_code` + `reason`, so "unlabelled on purpose" is machine-checked instead of a discipline. Adding a verb: append a row here, run `node design/emit.mjs --write`, commit app.js + design/emit-manifest.json. Order is the emitted order; it mirrors the noun grouping the old hand-list carried.

reason_codes.d582-copy-not-written: No console sentence fragment has been written for this verb yet. D582 ruled the raw dotted slug HONEST — humanAction(a) returns ACTION_LABELS[a] || a, so the row renders unpolished rather than disappearing. The reason must name the open row that owns the copy (a `cch-w…` slug), so the excuse points at its owner the way the Elixir census's @producerless anchors point at code.
reason_codes.no-producer: The verb is DECLARED but nothing in cloud/lib produces it, so no audit row can ever carry it and a label would name a category the feed cannot show. The reason must cite `@producerless` — the census allowlist in cloud/test/barkpark_cloud/audit_vocabulary_census_test.exs that already excuses it with an anchor/blocker pair.
